method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Betting Control Act 1954 (WA), compilation incorporating amendments to the Gambling Legislation Amendment Act 2024 (No. 53 of 2024), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/mrdoc_48877.txt (retrieved 7 September 2026); most of the TAB (Disposal) Act 2019 uncommenced; no regulations deposited

scope: From the seat of the gambler: what the Act makes of a bet made in WA with the TAB, the wagering licensee, a WA-licensed bookmaker, an interstate or offshore operator, an unlicensed bookmaker or a friend (ss 5, 22, 23, 24, 27A), the fine each risks; other offences on the person who bets (ss 21(2), 22, 22A, 23(2), 26, 26A, 26B, 26C(5), 27A(3), 30), forfeiture (s 28(2)), what the operator may not do to me (ss 10J(2), 21), the s 25 court order that no bookmaker bet with me, and disputes with a racecourse bookmaker (s 32). Licensing, levies, race fields, operators' duties and machinery out.
lives: jake k080 (2045-09-01): Lotto on Saturdays, the casino on paydays, then betting apps
